cohort: The study included 153 cases of foetal tachyarrhythmia diagnosed at two tertiary foetal cardiology centres in Sweden from 1990 to 2012.
finding: Transplacental treatment for foetal tachyarrhythmia was often insufficient for cardioversion in both hydropic and nonhydropic foetuses, though all nonhydropic cases had favourable outcomes and Sotalol was more effective than digoxin for AVRT.
